description: This file contains implementation of bit manipulation functions for a vector-based bit buffer, including packing and unpacking bits, with optimized SIMD code for x86 architectures.

methods.name: unpack_8bit
methods.description: Unpacks a byte into individual bits stored in a span of bytes.

methods.name: pack_8bit
methods.description: Packs 8 bits from a span of bytes into a single byte.

methods.name: bit_unpack
methods.description: Unpacks bits from a bit_buffer into a span of bytes.

methods.name: bit_unpack
methods.description: Unpacks bits from a bit_buffer into a span of bytes with an offset.

methods.name: bit_pack
methods.description: Packs bits from a span of bytes into an unsigned integer.

methods.name: bit_pack
methods.description: Packs bits from a span of bytes into an unsigned integer.

methods.name: bit_pack
methods.description: Packs bits from a span of bytes into a bit_buffer.

methods.name: bit_pack
methods.description: Packs bits from a span of bytes into a bit_buffer with an offset.

methods.name: copy_offset
methods.description: Copies bits from an input bit_buffer to an output bit_buffer starting at a specific position.

methods.name: copy_offset
methods.description: Copies bits between buffers with specified offsets and length.
